Subject: Final gating checklist & rollback triggers — alignment needed

Team,

We need a final alignment on the gating checklist and explicit rollback triggers for the Acme Retail go-live. I attached v3 of the checklist (gating-checklist-v3.xlsx) — it folds in the canary thresholds but I want clear, owner-assigned rollback criteria so on-call doesn’t improvise during cutover.

Key asks: 
- Owners: confirm one owner per checklist line (infra, runtime, console, pricing config, legal sign-off).
- Canary thresholds: confirm which metrics (p95 latency, error rate, embed-quality regression) and exact numeric thresholds.
- Rollback triggers: list top 3 immediate rollback triggers and the person empowered to flip the switch.
- Timing: proposed cutover windows (we currently have 10/05 02:00–05:00 UTC and 10/06 02:00–05:00 UTC). Any constraints?
- Docs/runbooks: confirm runbook and rollback-runbook.pdf are final and where they’ll be hosted.

Please reply with owner assignments and any changes to the thresholds by EOD today so I can push a consolidated version to leadership tomorrow morning.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. PM, Launch & Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachment: gating-checklist-v3.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final gating checklist & rollback triggers — alignment needed

Thanks Vanessa — quick notes inline (see bullets). I also attached a compact rollback runbook that operations can reference during the window (rollback-runbook.pdf).

- Owners: I can own runtime gating (kernel selection, cold-start metrics). Evelyn — can you own console/observability sign-off? Jonas — want you on the canary metric owner (you already have the tracing hooks).
- Canary thresholds: propose p95 < 180ms (tail for our configured slice), error rate < 0.5% spike over baseline for 5m consecutive samples, and embedding drift detection > 2.5% regressions on the eval set triggers immediate pause. If these are acceptable I’ll add them to the checklist.
- Rollback: primary trigger = sustained error-rate > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 > 300ms for 10m. Secondary trigger = data-quality regression flagged by model-evals pipeline. Person to execute rollback: Marcus Lin (runtime lead) or on-call SRE (see runbook).
- Timing: 10/05 window ok for me (we should keep a 2-hour buffer after canary to assess).

Open items: procurement/contract question — do we need procurement sign-off on the final SLA adjustments before we flip? cc'ing Karthik to confirm.

— Marcus
Lead, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rollback-runbook.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final gating checklist & rollback triggers — alignment needed

Agree with Marcus' thresholds with a tweak for canary sensitivity. Suggest we use a rolling window metric for error-rate (5m) but require a simultaneous spike on traces > 10% increase in slow-path calls to avoid false positives from a single noisy client. For embedding drift, let's tie to the production eval set and require 2 consecutive eval runs showing > 2.5% drift before pausing — reduces flapping.

I'll update the checklist on the Drive doc and mark the canary owner fields; no attachment from me.

On procurement: Karthik, if procurement needs the SLA amendment in DocuSign before we proceed, call it out today so we can adjust the cutover.

— Jonas
Head of Product Ops
Redwood Inference
